scope: Investigate Codex plugin UI and notifications after user rejected 0.1.0 visual design; no runtime, notification permission, hook, or daemon changes.

existing_ui.observed_design: Existing pink palette (#b52e70), original cat brand, status cards and event timeline.
existing_ui.decision: Reuse existing production website for details; do not introduce another visual identity.
existing_ui.unapproved_preview: design/logo-motion-preview-20261112 remains a separate, unapproved preview; not published by this research.

cases.name: Notify (macOS)
cases.verified_source_behavior: Stop/UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse hooks dispatch to alerter; native macOS banner with title/subtitle/body/icon/sound and session dedupe. README states Terminal bundle identity; this is not evidence of a Codex Activity inbox API.
cases.adopt: Compact system notification and no separate dashboard.
cases.do_not_adopt: Task transcript parsing, permission preview, or impersonating Codex notification ownership; our input is already public Cloudflare events.

cases.name: Codex Complete Notify
cases.verified_source_behavior: SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop register Python watchdog and sound handlers. README describes local audio and PushPlus delivery.
cases.adopt: Small setup and notification preference workflow.
cases.do_not_adopt: Private transcript/usage failure monitoring or additional PushPlus credential requirement for this public reset use case.

cases.name: Bits & Bolts (official MCP Extensions example)
cases.verified_source_behavior: Parts library global entrypoint and Parts Tray thread entrypoint; HTML uses host theme variables. A real custom UI surface, not a native notification center extension. Controller applies host-provided CSS variables, fonts and theme; this is the relevant native-feeling UI mechanism omitted in our first prototype.
cases.adopt: Use host surfaces for optional compact detail viewing; keep our existing site visual identity.

cases.name: Figma Workbench in public plugin repository
cases.verified_source_behavior: HTML explicitly labels Draft Widget / concept and uses example data.
cases.decision: Excluded as evidence of an established, production-verified Codex UI.

cases.name: CodexBar local provider plugins (independent app, not a Codex plugin)
cases.verified_source_behavior: Native menu cards for local JS/TS providers; fixed-origin HTTP and optional auth; a details-only snapshot is allowed. Plugins cannot spawn subprocesses or call arbitrary native APIs. Existing opt-in usage_updated hooks run after successful app refreshes. Native quota_reset detection requires real cadence and quota evidence, so an external public announcement must not be encoded as measured quota.
cases.adopt: Optional existing native status UI, with public Cloudflare data and a link to the original website.
cases.limits: Not installed or executed; custom external-event notification handling and packaging remain unverified. Another app would be required.

official_boundaries.finding: Documented built-in alerts concern turn completion, permissions/questions and task activity. notify invokes an external program for agent-turn-complete; it is not an inbound cloud reset event API. No verified public API was found to append arbitrary reset events to Codex own Activity notification center. This is a coverage gap, not proof that no private capability exists.

recommended_direction.primary: OS notification from a minimal local Cloudflare event reader; click opens existing website. No LLM.
recommended_direction.data: Keep unified Cloudflare collection; users do not provide X API keys.
recommended_direction.requirements: A local component must remain active for new external events; hooks alone run only at lifecycle points. SessionStart startup is an option, subject to user hook trust and OS notification permission. Closing the UI must not be confused with keeping a receiver alive.
recommended_direction.optional_ui: Existing production webpage or compact reused components as detail view, not a new dashboard.
not_implemented: OS toast adapter and its click behavior
